description.value:
Your blood echoes Hashirama's Wood Release. Plants visibly lean toward you, and you can sense living vegetation within 30 feet by touch on the ground.

You ignore difficult terrain caused by underbrush, vines, or thick foliage. Once per day, you can cause a square of natural ground within 5 feet of you to sprout a sapling that lasts 1 minute and counts as a thin pillar for cover.
